# Indexed painting rebase: matched native resource check

Registration ID: indexed-paint-20261110-v2. Registered before measurements. V1 was not executed and is invalid:50% red over white can legitimately quantize back to white, contradicting the required meaningful-edit check. V2 uses full stroke opacity and describes the input by image content, not assumed sparse storage.

Compare upstream main609e2aa72705ae8a43823f192d2aac9b51aa1620 (brush already fixed by #8823) with the final #8926 rebased implementation. Exact same temporary engine example source and Rust1.95 toolchain; release optimization3, LTO off, codegen-units16; same target directory, sequential builds with separately retained binary hashes. RAYON_NUM_THREADS=8. No other build/test jobs during measurement.

Before any measurement, candidate pinned to8610947f0bd8ad1731756d1e681e15a4b266fbf3; identical harness SHA2562501e1f168b4411120166e230e598e0f9a537e4172975a2da7127c01a5286d8a. After saving the baseline executable, invalidate only the owned target's release photocraft-engine package before building the candidate. Prior cross-worktree Cargo freshness failures make this necessary even though dependencies are unchanged. Save both compile logs and exact compiler-artifact source paths; no stale-build result counts.

Four cases:6000x4000 RGB/Indexed documents, each with uniform white or black/white64px vertical stripes; Indexed has fixed opaque black/white table. For each case run a121point stroke (seed7,60px soft brush,opacity1.0,smoothing0,red foreground), measuring cold commit and121live preview updates from a fresh document. Validate unchanged palette and live/final touched-region samples, and record native sample hashes. Setup/hash/undo excluded from timed regions. This compares a path supported and already palette-constrained on both revisions, not the formerly leaking tool matrix.

Run6matched process pairs, alternate executable order on even/odd trial; trial0 is warm-up, trials1-5 retained. Report each case's across-trial median commit_ms and median live_total_ms; live update p95 reported descriptively per trial. Do not pool RGB/Indexed or uniform/striped samples. Record total process peak RSS separately with /usr/bin/time where available; not interpreted as per-operation allocation.

Decision: flag a case for investigation only if candidate median is both >10% slower and adds >2ms to commit or >0.25ms per121-update average. Otherwise call it no large regression observed within this small local check, never a speedup or established budget. Five trials do not establish general performance parity. Timing pass cannot substitute for matrix correctness; all failed/incomplete invocations retained. If a fixture or equivalence check is invalid, mark this registration unusable and register a corrected version before fresh measurements; do not silently substitute.

Retention: temporary harness, both exact executable hashes, source pins, commands, all stdout/stderr and final estimator table retained in the source-scoped evidence receipt. Delete only owned executable/cache/fixture directories after uploaded evidence is downloaded and verified. No personal input images, no Photoshop oracle, no claim about formerly withdrawn3.0976x timings.

Primary acceptance remains unchanged: flag only when candidate median exceeds main by10% AND adds>2ms commit or>0.25ms average live update. Keep all raw invocations, including failures, and the source/binary identities. V2 and V3 are separate runs; do not pool or discard the flagged V2 observations. A passing small local V3 check is not established performance parity, a shipping budget or a speedup claim.
